confidence: High for the bounded fixture and supplied native evidence.

findings.description: All behavior represented by the 25 source rows is covered by complete staging, eligible-charge and gold exports. The fixture does not exercise a surviving damage_fee, a latest live active rental, a location tombstone, or equal CDC sequence with differing update timestamps. Those rule branches are correctly expressed in inspected SQL but are not independently qualified by these eight cases.

The denied-persona case verifies an explicit downstream tenant filter and expected empty result only. It does not verify authentication, real tenant grants, Omni identity binding, warehouse row-access policies or RLS.
Evidence establishes one local synthetic DuckDB exercise. Snowflake execution, live Omni queries, customer acceptance, production deployment and general reliability remain unverified.

scope: Independent read-only comparison of the host-extracted local native outputs with the analyst's pre-engineering synthetic oracle, plus candidate SQL, tests and documentation review. The analyst executed no new database queries and changed no input, oracle or candidate files.
